name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot CRM is a customer-relationship platform where businesses store contact and company data, track deals through a sales pipeline, and manage sales, marketing, and service activity, with AI assistance built in.
best_for: HubSpot positions the free CRM for startups and small businesses that want to start managing customers immediately and scale up without a data migration later.
features: AI assistant for record summarization and research

alternatives.name: Salesforce
alternatives.description: A cloud-based CRM platform that centralizes customer data across sales, service, marketing, and IT.
alternatives.best_for: Larger organizations wanting one AI-enabled platform across departments

alternatives.name: Pipedrive
alternatives.description: A sales-focused CRM built around a visual pipeline for tracking leads and deals.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized sales teams wanting a simpler pipeline view

alternatives.name: Zoho CRM
alternatives.description: A cloud-based sales platform using the Zia AI assistant to manage leads, deals, and customer relationships with omnichannel engagement and no-code workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses already using or considering the wider Zoho suite who want CRM bundled with dozens of adjacent apps
